theorems.name: Submission.tdo_ghe_setLIntegral_weight_le_mul
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (E : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (C : ℝ) (g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet E → Measurable g → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ E → V.mult x ≤ C) → ∫⁻ x in E, g x ∂V.weight ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * ∫⁻ x in E, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))
